normalization_plan.reason: from is only a formal argument of the _transfer function and carries no independent semantics
to is only a formal argument of the _transfer function and carries no independent semantics
amount is only a formal argument used for the max tx and cooldown requires in _transfer
contractTokenBalance is a temporary holder for balanceOf(address(this)) feeding the auto swap decision
contractETHBalance is a temporary holder for address(this).balance feeding sendETHToFee
tokenAmount is only a formal argument of the swap function
amount is only a formal argument split between the two fee wallets
bots_ is only the input array iterated by the blacklist loop
notbot is only the address argument cleared in the bots mapping
tAmount is only the formal amount argument consumed by _getValues
currentRate is a temporary rate value obtained from _getRate inside _takeTeam
